macros.name: hereapplies
macros.doc: The \hereapplies command notifies the document that one or more identifiers apply to a particular point and adds a label to it.

macros.name: whereapplies
macros.doc: The \whereapplies command prints all the occurrences of an identifier, in the form “p. . . . ” or “pp. . . . ” (with page range support).
